articles.summary: GrabAGun Digital Holdings Inc. (“GrabAGun” or the “Company”) (NYSE: PEW), an online retailer of firearms, ammunition and related accessories, today announced that it plans to report its fiscal 2026 third quarter results on Thursday, November 12, 2026, after the close of the U.S. stock market. Management will host a conference call and webcast at 4:30 PM ET the same day to discuss the results. The live webcast and replay will be accessible on the Events Presentations section of the Company’s Investor Relations website at: GrabAGun - Events Presentations . About GrabAGun Digital Holdings Inc. GrabAGun Digital Holdings Inc. (NYSE: PEW) is a technology-driven commerce and platform company serving the firearms, ammunition, and outdoor industry through two complementary businesses. articles.summary: GrabAGun Digital Holdings Inc. (“GrabAGun” or the “Company”) (NYSE:PEW) unapologetically supports the Second Amendment and applauds the Texas federal court’s decision in Silencer Shop Foundation v. ATF and ATF’s October 9, 2026 guidance. These are decisive victories for law-abiding Americans’ civil rights. The guidance ends federal enforcement of NFA registration and prior-approval requirements for suppressors, short-barreled rifles and shotguns, and other covered untaxed firearms. We thank President Trump for making this relief possible. We also thank ATF, Director Robert Cekada, Chief Counsel Robert Leider, and all of the agency’s hard-working staff. Law-abiding Americans have every reason to celebrate. articles.summary: Fourth manufacturer to join the platform since its January 2026 launch GrabAGun Digital Holdings Inc. (“GrabAGun” or the “Company”) (NYSE: PEW) and its wholly-owned subsidiary PEW Logistics LLC, a technology-driven commerce and fulfillment platform company powering the modern firearms and outdoor industry, today announced a strategic collaboration with Sarsilmaz (“Sarsilmaz”), one of the world’s largest privately held, vertically integrated firearms manufacturers, marking the fourth manufacturer to join the PEW Logistics platform. PEW Logistics will power the e-commerce experience at sarsilmaz.us, managing compliant order processing, Federal Firearms Licensee (“FFL”) routing, fulfillment and customer support behind the Sarsilmaz brand.
